title: procris puberula
intro: Procris puberula, commonly known as Himalayan Procris or Himalayan Grass, is a plant species belonging to the family Urticaceae. It is an herb used in traditional medicine, valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antiseptic properties. The therapeutic actions of Procris puberula include treating wounds, reducing fever, and alleviating respiratory issues such as coughs and colds. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
